profile.entities: Gabion Technologies India Limited; Gabion Nepal (subsidiary)
profile.subseg: Gabions; Slope Drapery Nettings; Geogrids; 3D Polymer Erosion Control Mats; Rockfall Protection Systems
profile.themes: Infrastructure Push; Capacity Expansion; Margin Expansion; Export Readiness

bull_bear.body: Capex funded via internal accruals (75%) + bank loan (24%) + IPO proceeds (1%); no dividend policy disclosed; focus on capacity expansion over buybacks or debt repayment
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Raw material price volatility (steel/polymer); execution delays on large projects; working capital cycle pressure (45-60 days product, 60-70 days service); competition from unlisted players (Secure Matrix, Techfire); government tender delays
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident, bullish on growth trajectory; emphasizes technical differentiation, execution capability, and capacity expansion; acknowledges past stagnation due to resource constraints but now fully resolved
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: INR15Cr unbilled WIP (not in order book) inflated inventory; 3D polymer mats are sole-manufactured in India; no distributors — direct engineer-led sales model; export potential locked behind capacity constraints; 90% of INR200Cr order book to be executed in FY27 itself
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Product sales: INR53Cr (FY26), 46% of revenue; Service/EPC: INR62.58Cr (FY26), 54% of revenue; Product margin: ~10%; Service margin: ~20%; 3D polymer mats sole-manufactured in India
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: Service margins (20%) > product margins (10%); cost insulation via bulk raw material booking (GI wire, polymer granules); steel/polymer price hikes mitigated by forward contracts; economies of scale from 18K MT capacity to drive 1-2% margin uplift
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: FY27 target INR200Cr (+73% YoY); FY28 target INR300Cr (+50% YoY); margin: +1-2% EBITDA margin expansion expected; order inflow: INR44Cr booked in May FY26 alone; capex/commissioning: INR8Cr total capex (FY26-FY27), INR1Cr from IPO proceeds; 18,000 MT capacity by Sept 2026
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: INR200Cr total; 50% product (INR100Cr), 50% project/EPC (INR100Cr); 50% from ongoing projects, 50% from new projects
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Export market entry planned post capacity expansion; potential to capture 20-25% of India’s geotechnical market; pipeline for INR300Cr+ revenue by FY28; new product R&D in progress
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Strong H2 FY26 margin expansion driven by service mix and operational leverage, coupled with capacity doubling to INR18K tons by Sept 2026, positions Gabion to triple revenue from INR115Cr to INR300Cr by FY28, with differentiated tech-driven solutions creating sustainable pricing power.

meta.thesis: Strong H2 FY26 margin expansion driven by service mix and operational leverage, coupled with capacity doubling to INR18K tons by Sept 2026, positions Gabion to triple revenue from INR115Cr to INR300Cr by FY28, with differentiated tech-driven solutions creating sustainable pricing power.
